content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with one of my two [product_name] communication modules. Both have a good signal and can receive SMS, but only one can successfully send SMS. When attempting to send a test SMS to my phone, the "Sending SMS failed" counter increases immediately on the status page. If I send a DIAG? message from my phone, the module receives a response, but the "Sending SMS failed" counter increases by two. The "Allow receipt of SMS messages" setting is enabled for my phone number. I have tried swapping the SIM cards between the modules, but the same module continues to have problems sending SMS. Could anyone assist?

Hi [user_name], Is there a PIN configured on your SIM cards? If there is, please remove the PIN from the SIM card in the non-functioning [product_name] module and set it up for mobile data without a PIN. After restarting the module, it should be able to send SMS messages again.
Hi, Removing the SIM card PIN resolved the issue. Now both sending and receiving SMS work properly. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users described a problem where a specific [product_name] communication module was unable to send SMS messages, although signal strength and SMS reception were normal. The issue was highlighted by immediate error counts during send attempts and was ultimately resolved by removing the SIM PIN, indicating PIN-protected SIMs were incompatible with SMS sending for this module.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] module to consistently send and receive SMS messages, regardless of SIM PIN settings, along with clear error indications and stable performance across devices.
